about: The rule registry (D-541, docs/RULES.md rule 2): every rule with its form. check and ratchet name the files that enforce them; judged names its reviewer and why it cannot be measured. The index in docs/RULES.md is generated from this file: node tools/agents/rules.mjs index.

rules.title: A PR from a fork or by anyone but the owner is red, never auto-merged
A game imports only shared code and its own folder, reaches no external host, and keeps its storage keys under juegos-de-salon:
Stylesheets use the design system's tokens and components (D-533)
Every name in the repo is English; the Spanish ones left only shrink (D-316, D-354)
Identity and tone
rules.why: tone, humour and celebration need a reader; fonts, instruction length and tokens are checked

rules.title: Structure of a game
rules.reviewer: the session building the game, with the checklist at the end of the canons
rules.why: reusing shared modules before writing one is a design call; the file layout becomes a check in #1249 step 12

rules.why: a translation that adapts rather than copies needs a reader; key parity is checked
